charts.title: Kepler-444 b: orbits around Kepler-444
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-444's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-444 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Campante et al. 2015 (2015ApJ...799..170C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CAMPANTE_ET_AL__2015): P 3.6001053 d
